notes.title: A major multiplayer update is live in Trash Sailors!
notes.notes:
Greetings brave sailors!

We have some really exciting news, a major update is live in Trash Sailors to enable much smoother and exhilarating rides for your multiplayer parties!

https://i.imgur.com/6YrBxwg.gif

Play it with the update now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

Check out the main changes in this update:

 This update will dramatically increase the multiplayer stability for different regions while making the connection conditions much less relevant to your multiplayer experience! 
 Quality of life improvement has been applied;
 Public matches are available now! If you have been looking forward to mingling with other sailors and playing not only with your friends but with random players online, now’s the time to start the game!


We understand that a lot of you sailors have been supporting us since our launch and that means more than anything to us. We have worked hard in the past few months for this really exciting news and hope this update elevates your multiplayer experience to a whole new level. Please feel free to let us know how you like the update in our community channels as usual!


 Discord
 Facebook
 Twitter
 Instagram
 Official Website


Have fun in the waves!

notes.title: Update - 31/01/2022
notes.notes:
Hello Sailors,

Today we have a quick update addressing various improvements and bug fixes.


 Improvements to online multiplayer and specifically those with slow a connection
 Synchronization fixes: flying players, missing treasures and obstacles, bugged animations should now appear
 Fixed a major bug with the tutorial on 2nd level
 Update to various controls issues (Keyboard and Controller)
 Steam Remote Play is now working correctly
 Update to audio including quiet and missing sounds.
 Mary's attacks have been made much easier to use
 Lobby canceling issues now fixed.


Thank you all for your patience, please feel free to share your thoughts in our social channels.

notes.title: An update is live to fix the previous issues for 4 players online!
notes.notes:
Hello sailors!

Thank you all for the patience and submitting feedback for the first day! We have previously noticed some players could experience major issues and long loading time when they play in a group of 4. 

We have been working to fix that and are glad to let you know that a fresh update is live now!

Please update the game and try it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

In this update we have:
[olist]
 Improved loading time
 Fixed critical issues for 4 players
 Fixed issues with missing obstacles for online players
[/olist]

Please feel free to update the game and try again! In the meantime, we are still constantly working on improving the online Co-Op experience so please let us know how this new update work for you! Thank you in advance!

As always, feel free to send your feedback through our channels!
